title: RT binding 3 = ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_KHR + KHR push descriptors
rationale: VUID 07990 indicates the fragment shader expects an acceleration structure at binding 3, but the pipeline layout or writes use COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER. Also mixed use of vkCmdPushDescriptorSet and vkCmdPushDescriptorSetKHR risks driver issues.

edits.action: When RT is enabled, set volumeBindings[3].descriptorType = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_KHR; keep binding index == 3. Ensure the same descriptor set layout object is used for both SDR and HDR volume pipelines to avoid layout divergence.

For binding 3 (when RT is supported): create VkWriteDescriptorSetAccelerationStructureKHR accelInfo { sType=..., accelerationStructureCount=1, pAccelerationStructures=&m_topLevelAS }; set descriptorWrites[3].sType=WRITE_DESCRIPTOR_SET; descriptorType=ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_KHR; pNext=&accelInfo; dstBinding=3; descriptorCount=1. Use vkCmdPushDescriptorSetKHR for the push.
Mirror the binding 3 AS write as above and push with vkCmdPushDescriptorSetKHR.
Replace any vkCmdPushDescriptorSet(...) with vkCmdPushDescriptorSetKHR(...). After volkLoadDevice, assert vkCmdPushDescriptorSetKHR != nullptr once (e.g., in VulkanContext or VolumeRenderer init).
Ensure #extension GL_EXT_ray_query : require is present and layout(binding=3) uniform accelerationStructureEXT topLevelAS; matches runtime binding index and descriptor type.

instrumentation: Log once per frame (guarded) when RT is enabled: pushed binding 3 as ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_KHR; AS handle non-null
On pipeline creation, print descriptor types for bindings 0..3
acceptance: No VUID 07990 at pipeline creation for both SDR and HDR volume pipelines
Frame renders without push-descriptor related errors
